Definition: Obed, the name of five Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Obed = "serving"; 1) son of Boaz by Ruth and the grandfather of David; 2) a Judaite, a descendant of Jarha, the Egyptian slave of Sheshan, in the line of Jerahmeel; 3) a Judaite, father of Azariah, one of the captains of hundreds who joined with Jehoiada in the revolution by which Athaliah fell; 4) one of David's mighty warriors; 5) son of Shemaiah and a gatekeeper of the temple
